metrics.ttft_mean_ms: Mean request first-token latency, then arithmetic mean over completed batches. Includes admission, scheduling, prefill and first-token production.
metrics.steady_state_output_tokens_per_s: Aggregate output rate from last request first-token arrival to first request completion, using token-count interpolation.

decision: Candidate reverted. No robust Decode improvement, while mean ordinary-request TTFT increased at concurrency 32. Transport source remains unchanged.
profile_scope: Separate instrumented real-model run. Windows 1/2 are concurrency 1/32; stage is identified by the maximum local input size across all ranks. Statistics kernels and timestamps add diagnostic overhead. Barrier timings are not unprofiled latency or pure network RTT; peer waits must not be summed across threads.

expert_profile.scope: Sum of the two fused_moe_kernel GEMMs per layer; excludes routing/packing and attention. Diagnostic trace only.

validation.followup_candidates: Compiled only, not validated across hosts or benchmarked; not included in the public runtime.

limitations: Single model and topology; no general congestion diagnosis from byte-count imbalance alone.
Three ordinary-request samples per workload; actual prefill admission can differ.
All model timing and sanity checks completed before access to one node was lost during cleanup. Further two-node validation is pending.
No per-peer credit protocol or hybrid forwarding is shipped by this experiment.
